name: GlzMenu
semanticRole: Present a compact, shallow action list including standard, contextual, and nested commands with deterministic keyboard navigation.

material.rule: Menus use Thick Glaze. Hierarchy stays shallow, destructive commands are separated, and Reduced Transparency resolves to an opaque menu surface.

input.keyboard: Arrow keys move within the menu, Home and End reach bounds, Enter or Space activates, directional arrows traverse submenus, and Escape closes to the invoker.
input.focus: Opening focuses an eligible item; closing restores invoker focus and disabled items are skipped.
input.hover: Hover may move active indication or open a submenu after intent delay, with equivalent keyboard access.
input.press: Press activates one enabled command and closes unless the command explicitly keeps the menu open.
input.selection: Checked or current menu items expose structural state and labels rather than color alone.

accessibility.role: Use menu and menuitem semantics, with checkbox or radio menu roles only for genuine stateful commands.
accessibility.name: Menu has a stable label from its trigger or context and each item has an actionable name.
accessibility.state: Expose disabled, checked, expanded submenu, and current state where applicable.
accessibility.value: Stateful items expose checked state; ordinary commands do not invent values.
accessibility.keyboard: Support arrow navigation, Home, End, activation, submenu traversal, and Escape dismissal.
accessibility.focus: Focus remains visibly within the open menu and returns to the invoking control on close.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Command failures are announced through a persistent status or error region rather than silent dismissal.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Submenus open directly or with a short crossfade.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen menu boundary, active item, focus, separators, and checked state.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system Menu, Canvas, Highlight, and focus colors with no blur.
accessibility.largeText: Long labels and shortcuts remain readable at 200% text and the menu stays within the viewport.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct submenu state changes or short crossfades.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen focus, selection, and necessary separators.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors with structural selection and focus cues.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and decorative shadow before altering menu geometry or keyboard behavior.

content.overflow: Use bounded widths; long labels may wrap or ellipsize only when the full accessible name remains available. Submenus flip before clipping.
content.localization: Command labels and shortcuts tolerate 30–50% expansion and destructive wording stays explicit.
content.rtl: Directional submenu indicators and start or end alignment mirror semantically.

criteria: Menu remains compact and scan-friendly rather than becoming a translucent card stack.
Destructive commands are separated without making routine commands alarm-like.
Keyboard focus, checked state, and disabled state remain distinct without color-only meaning.
